content.value_statement: Metabase docs need clear, consistent guidance for different readers. This skill applies Metabase writing rules for structure, tone, links, examples, and formatting.
actual_capabilities: Guides writing and editing for Metabase documentation files.
Applies a clear, conversational, user-focused documentation style.
Encourages task-first structure, direct headings, and working examples.
Checks conventions for links, code spans, UI labels, and American spelling.
Recommends running Prettier after documentation edits.
limitations: It does not validate product behavior without repository context or tests.
It does not include the referenced shared style guide in this package.
It does not create or verify screenshots.
It requires human review for technical accuracy and release-sensitive details.

use_cases.title: Update Feature Documentation
use_cases.description: Turn product changes into clear task-based documentation with practical examples and direct headings.

use_cases.title: Standardize Existing Pages
use_cases.description: Revise Markdown or MDX pages so tone, links, labels, and examples follow Metabase conventions.

use_cases.title: Create Support Guidance
use_cases.description: Write troubleshooting or setup guidance that answers common reader questions without extra explanation.

prompt_templates.title: Draft A Basic Doc
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a new documentation page.
prompt_templates.prompt: Write a Metabase documentation draft for [task]. Use clear headings, direct steps, and practical examples.

prompt_templates.title: Improve Existing Copy
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request to edit a page for style.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Metabase documentation page for tone, headings, links, UI labels, and unnecessary detail: [paste text].

prompt_templates.title: Restructure A Guide
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request to reorganize a long or unclear page.
prompt_templates.prompt: Restructure this guide so readers reach the answer faster. Keep useful details and remove repeated or outdated content: [paste text].

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Final Documentation
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request before a documentation change is merged.
prompt_templates.prompt: Edit this documentation for Metabase style, verify examples for clarity, flag release-sensitive claims, and list final review items: [paste text].

output_examples.input: Create a short guide for setting SAML before inviting people.
output_examples.output: A task-first draft with a direct heading, setup steps, and a short explanation of why SAML should be configured first.

output_examples.input: Review an existing page for tone and formatting.
output: Vague links replaced with descriptive link text.
UI labels marked in bold text.
Outdated or unsupported claims flagged for review.

output_examples.input: Turn support notes into customer-facing docs.
output_examples.output: A cleaned documentation outline that leads with the solution, keeps troubleshooting steps focused, and removes internal-only details.

best_practices: Provide the target reader, product area, and source material before asking for a draft.
Ask the skill to flag claims that need product verification.
Run the project formatter after accepting documentation edits.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for broad marketing copy when you need task documentation.
Do not accept examples without checking that they work.
Do not use vague link text or headings that hide the reader action.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It helps write and edit Metabase documentation with clear structure, reader-focused tone, and consistent Markdown or MDX formatting.

faq.question: Can it create new documentation pages?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide the product area, audience, and source notes so it can draft a focused page.

faq.question: Can it review existing documentation?
faq.answer: Yes. It can improve headings, remove extra detail, adjust tone, and flag claims that need verification.

faq.question: Does it verify technical accuracy?
faq.answer: It can flag risky or unclear claims, but a human should verify product behavior and examples.

faq.question: Which tools support this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it run commands automatically?
faq.answer: The skill recommends running Prettier after edits. Users should review command context before running project tools.
